content: निष्ठ {%a.%} [नि-स्था-क षत्वटुत्वे] (Usually at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) .²1 Being in or on, situated on; तन्निष्ठे फेने. .²2 Depending or resting on, referring or relating to; तमोनिष्ठाः <ls>Ms. 12. 95</ls>. .²3 Devoted or attached to, practising, intent on; सत्यनिष्ठ. .²4 Skilled in. .²5 Believing in; धर्मनिष्ठ. 6 Conducive to, effecting; हेमाम्भोज स्रजस्ते विशद सुमहते प्लोषपोषाय निष्ठाः <ls>B. R. 5. 51</ls>. .{@-ष्ठा@} .²1 Position, condition, state; तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण <ls>Bg. 17. 1</ls>; तेषामशान्तकामानां का निष्ठाऽविजितात्मनाम् <ls>Bhāg. 11. 5. 1</ls>. .²2 Basis, foundation. .²3 Fixity, fixedness, steadiness; मनो निष्ठाशून्यं भ्रमति च किमप्यालिखति च <ls>Māl. 1. 31</ls>. .²4 Devotion or application, close attachment. .²5 Belief, firm adherence, faith; शास्त्रेषु निष्ठा <ls>Māl. 3. 11</ls>; लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयाऽनघ <ls>Bg. 3. 3</ls>. .²6 Excellence, skill, proficiency, perfection. .²7 Conclusion, end, termination; (शृणु) चरितं पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य यथा निष्ठां गतश्च सः <ls>Mb. 1. 49. 6</ls>; अत्यारूढिर्भवति महतामप्यपभ्रंशनिष्ठा <ls>Ś. 4. 3</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>). .²8 The catastrophe or end of a drama. .²9 Accomplishment, completion (समाप्ति); पाणिग्रहणिका मन्त्रा नियतं दारलक्षणम् . तेषां निष्ठा तु विज्ञेया विद्वद्भिः सप्तमे पदे .. <ls>Ms. 8. 227</ls>. .²10 The culminating point; इयं च निष्ठा नियतं प्रजानाम् <ls>Bu. Ch. 3. 61</ls>. .²11 Death, destruction, disappearance from the world at the fixed time. .²12 Fixed or certain knowledge, certainty. .²13 Begging. .²14 Suffering, trouble, distress, anxiety. .²15 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) A technical term for the past participial terminations क्त, क्तवतु ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} त and तवत.) .²16 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu.
